mapper.select: SELECT char_length(db.doctorname) as doctorname_len ,db.doctorname, h.baseName FROM doctor_basic db INNER JOIN hospital h ON db.hid = h.hid WHERE char_length(db.doctorname) > 3 and db.doctorname like '%교수' ORDER BY db.createAt ASC
SELECT db.doctorname, h.baseName, db.doctor_url FROM doctor_basic db INNER JOIN hospital h ON db.hid = h.hid WHERE db.doctor_url is null or db.doctor_url = '' ORDER BY db.createAt ASC

SELECT db.doctorname, h.baseName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',1) as url_a, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',2) as url_b, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',3) as url_c, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',4) as url_d, db.doctor_url FROM doctor_basic db INNER JOIN hospital h ON db.hid = h.hid WHERE 1=1 and ( SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',1) != 'http:' and SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',1) != 'https:' ) ORDER BY db.createAt ASC

SELECT db.doctorname, h.baseName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',1) as url_a, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',2) as url_b, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',3) as url_c, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',4) as url_d, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',5) as url_e, db.doctor_url FROM doctor_basic db INNER JOIN hospital h ON db.hid = h.hid WHERE 1=1 and SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',3) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.doctor_url,'/',4) ORDER BY db.createAt ASC

SELECT db2.hid, MAX(h.baseName) as hospital_name, COUNT(db2.rid) as regist_doctors, IFNULL(max(db.db_doctor),0) as null_doctor, ROUND(IFNULL(MAX(db.db_doctor),0)/COUNT(db2.rid),1)*100 as null_percentage FROM doctor_basic db2 left join ( SELECT h.hid ,COUNT(DISTINCT(db.rid)) as db_doctor FROM doctor_basic db LEFT JOIN hospital h ON db.hid = h.hid WHERE 1=1 and ( db.specialties = '' OR db.specialties is null ) GROUP BY db.hid ) AS db ON db.hid = db2.hid LEFT JOIN hospital h on db2.hid = h.hid GROUP BY db2.hid

SELECT db.doctorname, h.baseName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl ,'/',1) as url_a, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',2) as url_b, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',3) as url_c, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',4) as url_d, db.profileimgurl FROM doctor_basic db INNER JOIN hospital h ON db.hid = h.hid WHERE 1=1 and ( SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',1) != 'http:' and SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',1) != 'https:' ) ORDER BY db.createAt ASC

SELECT db.doctorname, h.baseName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',1) as url_a, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',2) as url_b, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',3) as url_c, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',4) as url_d, SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',5) as url_e, db.profileimgurl FROM doctor_basic db INNER JOIN hospital h ON db.hid = h.hid WHERE 1=1 and SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',3) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(db.profileimgurl,'/',4) ORDER BY db.createAt ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_cnt ,SUM(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(dp.title, '[가-힝]') = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as hangul_cnt ,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(dp.title, '[가-힝]') = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) /COUNT(*),1)*100 as hangul_percentage FROM doctor_paper dp WHERE 1=1
